title: Your watches, thoughtfully presented
intro: Prepare the details, show the condition, and let the right watch find its next owner.
emptyBody: Create a durable draft. Nothing becomes public until your seller verification, photos, fees and sale registration are confirmed.
verificationHint: Keep preparing your draft. Publication requires current private-seller approval.
signInBody: Your listing drafts and private documents belong only to you or your authorized business. Sign in before opening the studio.
error: We couldn't complete that request. Your last acknowledged draft is safe.
unavailable: This service is temporarily unavailable. No sale or payment has been assumed.
forbidden: You do not have current permission for this watch or business.
stale: This watch changed elsewhere. Reload the latest revision before saving.
noDocuments: No documents supplied — disclose this honestly
ownership: I own this watch or am authorized to sell it for this business.
modifiedQuestion: Have any components been modified or replaced?
no: No modification disclosed (not an originality guarantee)
disclosureHint: A modified resale watch is not platform stock or a brand customization approval. Never imply factory endorsement.
photoHint: JPEG or PNG • 8 MB each • 20 million decoded pixels • 12 photos. Metadata is removed; three aspect-preserving sizes are generated.
documentHint: Private JPEG, PNG or PDF • 8 MB each • 5 documents. Never shown in the public gallery.
photoSafety: I checked that these photographs show only the watch: no identity documents, former-owner details or full serial numbers.
feeHint: Fees are a versioned demonstration policy, not a commercial promise. Review a current quote before publishing.
publishedBody: This watch is now published in the real catalog. Publication is not a payment, inspection pass or warranty.
pendingBody: The physical-watch commitment is not yet confirmed. Retry the same operation; the watch remains private while pending.
complete: Complete required details, add a safe photo and explicitly answer the modification question.
creditsIntro: Real openly licensed photography, illustrative stock. These photographs do not prove ownership, authenticity, condition or an endorsement.
changes: Oriented, metadata removed and resized while preserving aspect ratio. Derivatives retain the stated image license; unrelated application code is not relicensed.
workspaceIntro: Your actual drafts, live watches and next steps, with each source checked independently.
noAuctions: No auctions have been opened yet.
payoutHint: No payout is implied. Confirmed payment, receipt, dispute-window completion and release are prerequisites.
